title: Original Mexican Shrimp Cocktail
description: Shrimp with tomatoes, avocados, sweet onion, and cilantro bask in a zesty tomato salsa for an appetizer that looks beautiful served in a glass salad bowl.
ingredients: 1 cup sweet onion (such as Vidalia®), diced
0.5 cup tomato and clam juice cocktail
2 teaspoons hot pepper sauce (such as Tapatio®)
1 pound frozen cooked shrimp - thawed, peeled, and deveined
2 ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and cubed

steps.text: Mix together Roma tomatoes, sweet onion, ketchup, tomato and clam juice cocktail, salsa, cilantro, salsa verde, lime juice, hot pepper sauce, and garlic in a glass salad bowl until well combined; cover the bowl and refrigerate until cold, about 1 hour.
Cut tails from shrimp, if present, and gently fold into chilled tomato mixture. Stir avocado into shrimp cocktail until incorporated.
